biggest_catch: Most proposals lose and only 15 bids per month are free — earnings depend entirely on winning client work, minus a tiered commission.
catches: Only 15 free proposal credits per month; extra credits are paid.
A tiered freelancer commission applies per client — check the current official fee schedule at signup.
Competitive bidding; most proposals earn nothing.
Payment goes through escrow with a clearing period before withdrawal; confirm current terms at signup.
New-seller application can take days unless expedited.

c1.evidence: PeoplePerHour's own 'How It Works - Freelancer' page describes the marketplace: freelancers 'Send Proposals in seconds', 'Quote a price', and use escrow-protected WorkStream; official support confirms 'all users are given 15 Proposal credits completely free' each month.

c2.evidence: Official pages publish no fixed freelancer pay range — freelancers quote their own prices per proposal; framed as variable.

c3.evidence: Steps follow the official flow: profile, browse projects, send proposals or publish Offers, escrow deposit, invoice, paid on release.

c4.evidence: Signup, project search, and 15 monthly proposals are free per official support; extra credits and memberships are optional.

eligibility: Anyone who can register and legally freelance; skills must match posted projects.
notes: Scenario: freelance bidding. PeoplePerHour is a project-bidding marketplace (UK/Europe-strong): clients post projects, freelancers send proposals or sell fixed-price Offers, and paid work runs through escrow. Pay is per-project and variable — never guaranteed.
numeric_basis: payout: per-project, freelancer-quoted prices, no official fixed range. time: profile + portfolio setup + reading and submitting first proposals, est. 45-120 min active.
payout_quote: Stay protected: set a deposit to go in Escrow! This will be released to you on invoicing
payout_value_note: Freelancers quote their own prices per proposal/Offer; PeoplePerHour publishes no fixed pay range — variable per-project income.

steps: Create a free PeoplePerHour freelancer profile with skills, portfolio, and rates.
Browse client-posted projects and send proposals — 15 proposal credits free each month per official support.
Alternatively, publish fixed-price 'Offers' that buyers can purchase directly.
Agree terms; the buyer deposits funds in escrow via WorkStream.
Deliver the work, raise an invoice, and get paid on release (tiered freelancer commission applies).
timing: Projects post continuously; escrow releases to the freelancer on invoicing/approval.
